primary_source.publisher: Soter Services North America LLC via PR Newswire
primary_source.normalized_excerpt: Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire: Soter Insure announced that SC Ventures and Japanese financial group SBI Group joined its Series B as strategic investors, adding to the round led by Galaxy. The second close includes follow-on investment from Token Bay Capital. Coinbase Ventures, Franklin Templeton and Brevan Howard Digital participated in the first close announced in July 2026. Soter says proceeds will increase insurance capacity, deepen underwriting and technology capabilities, and expand in Asia-Pacific through Hong Kong, Europe and the US. No individual investor amounts are disclosed in the release.

proceeds_use: expand in Asia-Pacific through Hong Kong

limitations: This is a company-issued announcement distributed by PR Newswire, not an audited cap table or investment agreement.
The announcement does not identify individual investment amounts, valuation or investor ownership percentages.
The announcement does not disclose an XRP-specific product, XRP investment or XRP payment/custody mandate.
